title: DirectImageHomologyAffineDetection
statement: For any scheme morphism $f:X\to S$ [def-pc-scheme], $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], and $m\in\mathbf Z$, if $H^m(R\Gamma(f^{-1}U,E))=0$ for every affine open $U\subset S$ [def-pc-open-module-derived-sections], then $H^m(Rf_*E)=0$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. No quasi-coherence, support, or quasi-compactness hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Represent E by a K-injective complex I, using DerivedCategory.exists_iso_Q_obj_of_isKInjective. The right derived functors of open sections and direct image are computed by their termwise functors on I [def-pc-open-module-derived-sections, def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. Thus the hypothesis is zero section homology of the complex K=f_*I on every affine open. The Lean proof transports it using rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso and homologyFunctorFactors.

Form the underlying abelian presheaf complex L of K and its degree-m homology presheaf P. Exact evaluation identifies P(U) with section homology, so P is zero on affine opens. Every stalk element of P has an affine representative by Scheme.isBasis_affineOpens and TopCat.Presheaf.exists_mem_germ_eq_of_isBasis. It is the germ of zero, hence zero. Exactness of filtered abelian colimits identifies this stalk with homology of the stalk complex. Exactness of the module-to-abelian-sheaf functor and of abelian sheaf stalks identifies the latter with the stalk of the cohomology sheaf of K. These are ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso comparisons.

TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_iff_stalkFunctor_obj_isZero makes the underlying abelian cohomology sheaf zero. Faithfulness of SheafOfModules.toSheaf reflects that its identity is zero, hence the module cohomology sheaf is zero. Transport back along the K-injective right-derived-functor comparison to obtain the conclusion. No support or quasi-coherence hypothesis has been used.
